   The local version of the "ffhash_inc.f90" file includes 
   a modification to the "store_key" subroutine that returns 
   -2 when a duplicate key is found. 
   Do not overwrite the modified file with the GitHub version 
   until the change is included upstream. 
   Please follow the pull request for updates: 
   https://github.com/jannisteunissen/ffhash/pull/3.
